A quick introduction to what I study, what I enjoy working on, and the principles that guide my work.

I’m pursuing a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering at the University of Petroleum and Energy Studies (UPES), Dehradun. My interests lie in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and software development.

Through academic and personal projects, I’ve worked on AI-powered applications, data processing pipelines, chatbot experiences, and practical problem-solving. I enjoy understanding how systems work and building solutions that are useful beyond the code itself.

I value clear communication, teamwork, and continuous improvement. I’m always looking to strengthen my fundamentals while exploring new technologies and meaningful technical challenges.
